ios.desc:
The original Hidden Camera Detector — featured by Forbes, Fox, and Yahoo News.

Checking into a hotel, rental, or Airbnb? Using a changing room, restroom, or office? Hidden Camera Detector helps you check your surroundings for hidden cameras, trackers, and suspicious devices using multiple detection methods in one easy app.

Scan again wherever you go to see if the same trackers or devices keep appearing with you over time.

Try every detection method before deciding if Pro is right for you.

Built on patented detection technology developed across our consumer and enterprise security products, Hidden Camera Detector brings multiple detection methods together in one consumer app.

BLUETOOTH & TRACKER SCAN
Find nearby Bluetooth devices and supported trackers. Many devices are identified by name, and live signal strength helps you physically locate them.

NETWORK / WI-FI SCAN
Scan your local network for connected devices. Hidden Camera Detector now identifies many devices by name and type, making unfamiliar cameras and other devices easier to recognize and investigate.

AI IMAGE RECOGNITION
Take a photo of a suspicious object and our AI compares it with known spy cameras, returning similar images, links, and descriptions.

LENS & IR REFLECTION DETECTOR
Scan the space around you live for reflections that may come from a camera lens using our classic lens-detection technology.

EXPERT VIDEO GUIDES — FREE
Watch security professionals show where hidden cameras are commonly concealed, along with quick demonstrations of the detection methods.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE HIDDEN CAMERA DETECTOR
• Scan again over time to see if the same devices keep appearing with you
• The original hidden camera detector app, built on patented detection technology and with over 2 million downloads
• Featured by Forbes, Fox, and Yahoo News
• Multiple detection methods — network device identification, Bluetooth and tracker locating, AI photo recognition, and live lens reflection scanning
• Many network and Bluetooth devices identified by name
• Live signal strength helps you locate nearby Bluetooth devices and supported trackers
• Simple enough for anyone — at home, traveling, or on the go

No app can guarantee it will find every hidden device, but Hidden Camera Detector gives you multiple practical ways to check a space and investigate suspicious devices with greater confidence.

quotes.text:
So no reason that driverless cars can't be misused lots of other ways, by everyone.  Sending bombs, civilians spying on government and police, anyone spying on anyone, stalking, sale of illicit items, and more I'm sure.  The real problem is the cameras, not the cars.  Anyone can put a camera anywhere and make it mobile by attaching it to anything mobile.

An automated camera detector (which looks for light reflection off a camera lens) would be useful as a cheap, easily available tool.  You can get cheap manual ones on eBay.  An augmented reality one should be possible to build as a cell phone app.  Maybe one exists already?  Yes, they do:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hiddencamdetect.techcamdetect&gl=US

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wondertechstudio.hiddendevicedetectorandcameradetector&gl=US

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hidden-camera-detector/id532882360

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spycam-detector/id1507203634

Easy to dedicate a cheap phone to detect cameras everywhere.

The other issue is who gets to decide what the police can do?  This comes up over and over, where the police see there is nothing preventing them from doing something so they do it, regardless of whether it is a good idea for society and with no oversight.  We don't just need laws regulating what the police (and CIA and NSA, and DHS, President, Senate, House, town officials, etc.) do _after_ they do something bad, we need live, real time oversight of decision …
quotes.story_title: San Francisco police use driverless cars for surveillance
